# Motion Lab v2.0 — Complete AI Reference

- Live Site: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/
- Registry JSON: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/registry.json
- Repository: https://github.com/17860288878k-debug/motion-lab
- Inventory: 12 interactive motion studies + 8 interactive UI components + 6 easing curves + 7 duration tokens (zero runtime dependencies).

## Design Principles
- Use asymmetric open/close durations (e.g., 250ms open / 150ms close) so UI feels snappy yet never abrupt.
- Default to architectural smooth-out cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); reserve bounce/pop overshoot strictly for small tactile feedback.
- Always support mid-flight interruption by transitioning CSS properties or clearing pending timers on re-trigger.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce on both CSS transitions/animations and JS pointer/timer effects.
- Use tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) on animated counters, timers, temperatures, and percentages to prevent layout jitter.

## Core CSS Tokens
```css
:root {
  --ml-speed: 1;
  --duration-stagger: 40ms;
  --duration-micro: 80ms;
  --duration-quick: 150ms;
  --duration-fast: 250ms;
  --duration-medium: 350ms;
  --duration-slow: 400ms;
  --duration-very-slow: 500ms;

  --ease-smooth-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1);
  --ease-pop: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.96, 0.64, 1);
  --ease-bounce-strong: cubic-bezier(0.34, 3.85, 0.64, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
```

## Reduced-Motion Guard
```css
/* Reduced-motion guard (system preference OR workbench live simulator) */
.ml-reduced-motion *,
.ml-reduced-motion *::before,
.ml-reduced-motion *::after {
  animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
  transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}
```

---

## 12 Interactive Motion Studies

### Adaptive Card Resize (`adaptive-card`)
- **Category**: Surfaces | **Spec**: 300ms · smooth-out | **Triggers**: Click / Mid-flight interrupt
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=adaptive-card
- **Rationale**: Uses a decelerating smooth-out curve so layout changes feel responsive immediately on click and settle cleanly without bounce.

#### CSS
```css
/* 1. Adaptive Card Resize */
.st-resize-card {
  --s-dur: 300ms;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);
  width: 232px;
  height: 112px;
  padding: 14px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--ml-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--ml-border);
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-md);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    width calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease),
    height calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-resize-card.is-compact {
  width: 162px;
  height: 138px;
}

.st-resize-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.st-resize-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ml-success);
}

.st-bar {
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: var(--ml-surface-subtle);
}

.st-bar.w80 { width: 80%; }
.st-bar.w60 { width: 60%; }
.st-bar.w92 { width: 92%; }
.st-bar.w45 { width: 45%; }
```

#### JS Controller
```js
if (id === "adaptive-card") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-resize-card" data-target>
          <div class="st-resize-head"><span>Release Build</span><span class="st-resize-dot"></span></div>
          <div class="st-bar w92"></div>
          <div class="st-bar w60"></div>
          <div class="st-bar w80"></div>
          <div class="st-bar w45"></div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="st-trigger" data-action>Toggle Size</button>
      `;
      const card = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      const btn = container.querySelector("[data-action]");
      rootTarget = card;
      triggerPrimary = () => {
        const compact = card.classList.toggle("is-compact");
        emit(`adaptive-card → ${compact ? "compact (162×138)" : "expanded (232×112)"}`);
      };
      btn.addEventListener("click", triggerPrimary);
    }
```

### Origin-Aware Action Menu (`origin-menu`)
- **Category**: Surfaces | **Spec**: 250ms in / 150ms out | **Triggers**: Click / Outside dismiss / Escape / Interrupt
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=origin-menu
- **Rationale**: Transform origin locks to top-center so the surface expands from its button; closing is 100ms faster with softer scale (0.99) to stay out of the user's way.

#### CSS
```css
/* 2. Origin-Aware Action Menu */
.st-menu-anchor {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 112px;
}

.st-menu-btn {
  height: 36px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ml-border-strong);
  background: var(--ml-surface);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-sm);
}

.st-menu-pop {
  --s-open-dur: 250ms;
  --s-close-dur: 150ms;
  --s-pre-scale: 0.97;
  --s-close-scale: 0.99;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);
  position: absolute;
  top: 44px;
  width: 196px;
  padding: 6px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--ml-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--ml-border);
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-lg);
  transform-origin: top center;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-4px) scale(var(--s-pre-scale));
  pointer-events: none;
  transition:
    opacity calc(var(--s-close-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease),
    transform calc(var(--s-close-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-menu-pop.is-open {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  pointer-events: auto;
  transition:
    opacity calc(var(--s-open-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease),
    transform calc(var(--s-open-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-menu-pop.is-closing {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-2px) scale(var(--s-close-scale));
}

.st-menu-item {
  width: 100%;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 13px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.st-menu-item:hover {
  background: var(--ml-surface-subtle);
}

.st-menu-item.is-selected {
  color: var(--ml-accent);
  font-weight: 600;
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "origin-menu") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-menu-anchor">
          <button type="button" class="st-menu-btn" aria-expanded="false" data-menu-btn>
            <span>Actions</span>
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 6l4 4 4-4"/></svg>
          </button>
          <div class="st-menu-pop" role="menu" data-target>
            <button type="button" class="st-menu-item is-selected" role="menuitem" data-item="Duplicate"><span>Duplicate</span><span>⌘D</span></button>
            <button type="button" class="st-menu-item" role="menuitem" data-item="Inspect Tokens"><span>Inspect Tokens</span><span>⌘I</span></button>
            <button type="button" class="st-menu-item" role="menuitem" data-item="Export Preset"><span>Export Preset</span><span>⌘E</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      const btn = container.querySelector("[data-menu-btn]");
      const pop = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      rootTarget = pop;
      let open = false;

      function setOpen(next, reason) {
        if (next === open) return;
        open = next;
        btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
        const cs = getComputedStyle(pop);
        const openDur = (pop.style.getPropertyValue("--s-open-dur") || cs.getPropertyValue("--s-open-dur") || "250ms").trim();
        const closeDur = (pop.style.getPropertyValue("--s-close-dur") || cs.getPropertyValue("--s-close-dur") || "150ms").trim();
        const preScale = (pop.style.getPropertyValue("--s-pre-scale") || cs.getPropertyValue("--s-pre-scale") || "0.97").trim();

        if (open) {
          // Ensure every open starts cleanly from tuned --s-pre-scale rather than stale .is-closing state
          pop.classList.remove("is-closing");
          void pop.offsetWidth;
          pop.classList.add("is-open");
          emit(`origin-menu → open (${openDur}, scale ${preScale}→1)`);
        } else {
          pop.classList.remove("is-open");
          pop.classList.add("is-closing");
          emit(`origin-menu → close (${reason ? `${reason}, ` : ""}${closeDur}, scale 1→0.99)`);
        }
      }

      pop.addEventListener("transitionend", (e) => {
        if (!open && e.propertyName === "opacity") {
          pop.classList.remove("is-closing");
        }
      });

      triggerPrimary = () => setOpen(!open);
      btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setOpen(!open); });
      pop.querySelectorAll("[data-item]").forEach((it) => {
        it.addEventListener("click", () => {
          pop.querySelectorAll("[data-item]").forEach((x) => x.classList.remove("is-selected"));
          it.classList.add("is-selected");
          emit(`origin-menu selected "${it.dataset.item}"`);
          setOpen(false, "selected");
        });
      });

      const onDocClick = (e) => {
        if (open && !pop.contains(e.target) && !btn.contains(e.target)) {
          setOpen(false, "outside click");
        }
      };
      const onDocKeydown = (e) => {
        if (open && e.key === "Escape") {
          e.preventDefault();
          setOpen(false, "Escape");
          btn.focus();
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener("click", onDocClick);
      document.addEventListener("keydown", onDocKeydown);
      cleanups.push(() => {
        document.removeEventListener("click", onDocClick);
        document.removeEventListener("keydown", onDocKeydown);
      });
    }
```

### Focal Scale Dialog (`scale-dialog`)
- **Category**: Surfaces | **Spec**: 250ms in / 150ms out | **Triggers**: Click / Backdrop / Escape
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=scale-dialog
- **Rationale**: Starting at 0.96 instead of 0.8 keeps focal modals crisp and architectural rather than cartoonish.

#### CSS
```css
/* 3. Focal Scale Dialog */
.st-dialog-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}

.st-dialog-veil {
  --s-open-dur: 250ms;
  --s-close-dur: 150ms;
  --s-scale: 0.96;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(20, 22, 26, 0.24);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity calc(var(--s-close-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-dialog-veil.is-open {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transition: opacity calc(var(--s-open-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-dialog-box {
  width: 248px;
  padding: 16px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--ml-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--ml-border);
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-lg);
  transform: scale(var(--s-scale));
  opacity: 0;
  transition:
    transform calc(var(--s-close-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease),
    opacity calc(var(--s-close-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-dialog-veil.is-open .st-dialog-box {
  transform: scale(1);
  opacity: 1;
  transition:
    transform calc(var(--s-open-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease),
    opacity calc(var(--s-open-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-dialog-title {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.st-dialog-body {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--ml-ink-secondary);
}

.st-dialog-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "scale-dialog") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-dialog-wrap">
          <button type="button" class="ml-btn ml-btn-primary" data-open>Open Dialog</button>
          <div class="st-dialog-veil" data-target aria-hidden="true">
            <div class="st-dialog-box" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Publish Snapshot">
              <h3 class="st-dialog-title">Publish Snapshot?</h3>
              <p class="st-dialog-body">Motion tokens will lock to this release preset and remain reversible.</p>
              <div class="st-dialog-actions">
                <button type="button" class="st-chip-btn" data-close>Cancel</button>
                <button type="button" class="st-chip-btn" style="background:var(--ml-ink);color:var(--ml-bg);border-color:var(--ml-ink);" data-confirm>Confirm</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      const openBtn = container.querySelector("[data-open]");
      const veil = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      rootTarget = veil;
      let open = false;

      function setOpen(next, reason) {
        if (next === open) return;
        open = next;
        veil.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
        veil.setAttribute("aria-hidden", String(!open));
        const cs = getComputedStyle(veil);
        const openDur = (veil.style.getPropertyValue("--s-open-dur") || cs.getPropertyValue("--s-open-dur") || "250ms").trim();
        const closeDur = (veil.style.getPropertyValue("--s-close-dur") || cs.getPropertyValue("--s-close-dur") || "150ms").trim();
        const scale = (veil.style.getPropertyValue("--s-scale") || cs.getPropertyValue("--s-scale") || "0.96").trim();
        emit(`scale-dialog → ${open ? `open (${openDur}, ${scale}→1)` : `close (${reason || closeDur})`}`);
      }

      triggerPrimary = () => setOpen(!open, "toggle");
      openBtn.addEventListener("click", () => setOpen(true));
      veil.querySelector("[data-close]").addEventListener("click", () => setOpen(false, "cancel"));
      veil.querySelector("[data-confirm]").addEventListener("click", () => setOpen(false, "confirmed"));
      veil.addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target === veil) setOpen(false, "backdrop"); });

      const onDocKeydown = (e) => {
        if (open && e.key === "Escape") {
          e.preventDefault();
          setOpen(false, "Escape");
          openBtn.focus();
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener("keydown", onDocKeydown);
      cleanups.push(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onDocKeydown));
    }
```

### Measured Sliding Tabs (`sliding-tabs`)
- **Category**: Navigation | **Spec**: 250ms · measured pill | **Triggers**: Click / Rapid interrupt
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=sliding-tabs
- **Rationale**: Measures offsetLeft and offsetWidth of the target button on click and on ResizeObserver, keeping transform and width synchronized.

#### CSS
```css
/* 4. Measured Sliding Tabs */
.st-tabs-box {
  --s-dur: 250ms;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.st-tabs-bar {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: 4px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--ml-surface-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--ml-border);
}

.st-tabs-pill {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  left: 0;
  height: calc(100% - 8px);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--ml-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-sm);
  transition:
    transform calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease),
    width calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-tab-btn {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 7px 12px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ml-ink-secondary);
  transition: color calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-tab-btn[aria-selected="true"] {
  color: var(--ml-ink);
}

.st-tabs-caption {
  font-family: var(--ml-font-mono);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--ml-ink-muted);
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "sliding-tabs") {
      const tabs = ["Overview", "Curves", "Tokens", "Export"];
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-tabs-box" data-target>
          <div class="st-tabs-bar" role="tablist">
            <div class="st-tabs-pill" data-pill></div>
            ${tabs.map((t, i) => `<button type="button" class="st-tab-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="${i === 0}" data-idx="${i}">${t}</button>`).join("")}
          </div>
          <div class="st-tabs-caption" data-cap>Active panel: Overview</div>
        </div>
      `;
      const box = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      const pill = container.querySelector("[data-pill]");
      const btns = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[role='tab']"));
      const cap = container.querySelector("[data-cap]");
      rootTarget = box;
      let activeIdx = 0;

      function positionPill(idx, instant) {
        const b = btns[idx];
        if (!b) return;
        if (instant) pill.style.transition = "none";
        pill.style.width = `${b.offsetWidth}px`;
        pill.style.transform = `translateX(${b.offsetLeft}px)`;
        if (instant) {
          void pill.offsetWidth;
          pill.style.transition = "";
        }
      }

      function select(idx) {
        activeIdx = idx;
        btns.forEach((b, i) => b.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(i === idx)));
        positionPill(idx, false);
        cap.textContent = `Active panel: ${tabs[idx]}`;
        emit(`sliding-tabs → "${tabs[idx]}" (x=${btns[idx].offsetLeft}px, w=${btns[idx].offsetWidth}px)`);
      }

      btns.forEach((b, i) => b.addEventListener("click", () => select(i)));
      requestAnimationFrame(() => positionPill(0, true));
      if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
        const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => positionPill(activeIdx, true));
        ro.observe(box);
        cleanups.push(() => ro.disconnect());
      }
      triggerPrimary = () => select((activeIdx + 1) % tabs.length);
    }
```

### Grid-Row Accordion (`accordion-disclosure`)
- **Category**: Navigation | **Spec**: 250ms · 0fr ↔ 1fr | **Triggers**: Click / Toggle / Interrupt
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=accordion-disclosure
- **Rationale**: Animates grid-template-rows from 0fr to 1fr without hardcoded max-height hacks, preserving exact content height.

#### CSS
```css
/* 5. Grid-Row Accordion */
.st-acc {
  --s-dur: 250ms;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);
  width: 268px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--ml-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--ml-border);
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-sm);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.st-acc-item + .st-acc-item {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ml-border);
}

.st-acc-head {
  width: 100%;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.st-acc-chev {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  color: var(--ml-ink-muted);
  transition: transform calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-acc-head[aria-expanded="true"] .st-acc-chev {
  transform: scaleY(-1);
}

.st-acc-panel {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-acc-panel.is-open {
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
}

.st-acc-inner {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.st-acc-content {
  padding: 0 14px 12px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--ml-ink-secondary);
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "accordion-disclosure") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-acc" data-target>
          <div class="st-acc-item">
            <button type="button" class="st-acc-head" aria-expanded="false" data-acc="0">
              <span>Timing Guidelines</span>
              <svg class="st-acc-chev" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 6l4 4 4-4"/></svg>
            </button>
            <div class="st-acc-panel" data-panel="0">
              <div class="st-acc-inner">
                <div class="st-acc-content">Pair 250ms smooth-out opens with faster 150ms exits to keep UI crisp.</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="st-acc-item">
            <button type="button" class="st-acc-head" aria-expanded="false" data-acc="1">
              <span>Reduced Motion</span>
              <svg class="st-acc-chev" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 6l4 4 4-4"/></svg>
            </button>
            <div class="st-acc-panel" data-panel="1">
              <div class="st-acc-inner">
                <div class="st-acc-content">All studies honor prefers-reduced-motion without breaking disclosure states.</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      const acc = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      rootTarget = acc;
      const heads = Array.from(acc.querySelectorAll("[data-acc]"));
      const panels = Array.from(acc.querySelectorAll("[data-panel]"));

      function toggle(i) {
        const expanded = heads[i].getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
        heads[i].setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!expanded));
        panels[i].classList.toggle("is-open", !expanded);
        emit(`accordion[${i}] → ${!expanded ? "expanded (1fr)" : "collapsed (0fr)"}`);
      }
      heads.forEach((h, i) => h.addEventListener("click", () => toggle(i)));
      triggerPrimary = () => toggle(0);
    }
```

### Directional View Slide (`page-transition`)
- **Category**: Navigation | **Spec**: 250ms · ±10px + 3px blur | **Triggers**: Click Forward / Back
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=page-transition
- **Rationale**: Short spatial displacement paired with mild blur communicates hierarchy direction without causing motion fatigue.

#### CSS
```css
/* 6. Directional View Slide */
.st-pager {
  --s-dur: 250ms;
  --s-dist: 10px;
  --s-blur: 3px;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);
  position: relative;
  width: 254px;
  height: 158px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--ml-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--ml-border);
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-md);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.st-page {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  padding: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  transition:
    transform calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease),
    opacity calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease),
    filter calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-page.is-left {
  transform: translateX(calc(var(--s-dist) * -1));
  opacity: 0;
  filter: blur(var(--s-blur));
  pointer-events: none;
}

.st-page.is-right {
  transform: translateX(var(--s-dist));
  opacity: 0;
  filter: blur(var(--s-blur));
  pointer-events: none;
}

.st-page.is-active {
  transform: translateX(0);
  opacity: 1;
  filter: blur(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.st-page-row {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid var(--ml-border);
  background: var(--ml-bg);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.st-page-row:hover {
  border-color: var(--ml-accent);
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "page-transition") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-pager" data-target>
          <div class="st-page is-active" data-p1>
            <div style="font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ml-ink-muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;">Workspaces</div>
            <button type="button" class="st-page-row" data-go="Motion Core"><span>Motion Core</span><span>→</span></button>
            <button type="button" class="st-page-row" data-go="Mobile Kit"><span>Mobile Kit</span><span>→</span></button>
          </div>
          <div class="st-page is-right" data-p2>
            <button type="button" class="st-chip-btn" style="align-self:flex-start;" data-back>← Back</button>
            <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;" data-detail-title>Motion Core</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--ml-ink-secondary);">Directional translateX + 3px cross-blur preserves spatial context.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      const pager = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      const p1 = pager.querySelector("[data-p1]");
      const p2 = pager.querySelector("[data-p2]");
      const titleEl = pager.querySelector("[data-detail-title]");
      rootTarget = pager;
      let page = 1;

      function goForward(label) {
        if (label) titleEl.textContent = label;
        page = 2;
        p1.className = "st-page is-left";
        p2.className = "st-page is-active";
        emit(`page-transition → forward to "${titleEl.textContent}"`);
      }
      function goBack() {
        page = 1;
        p1.className = "st-page is-active";
        p2.className = "st-page is-right";
        emit("page-transition → back to Workspaces");
      }
      pager.querySelectorAll("[data-go]").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => goForward(b.dataset.go)));
      pager.querySelector("[data-back]").addEventListener("click", goBack);
      triggerPrimary = () => (page === 1 ? goForward("Motion Core") : goBack());
    }
```

### Stacked Notification Banners (`toast-stack`)
- **Category**: Feedback | **Spec**: 350ms in · Hover/Tap fan-out | **Triggers**: Click Push / Hover or Tap spread
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=toast-stack
- **Rationale**: Receding cards scale down by 6% per layer with progressive opacity and blur, then unfold cleanly into a full list on hover or mobile tap.

#### CSS
```css
/* 7. Stacked Notification Banners */
.st-stack-wrap {
  --s-open: 350ms;
  --s-close: 250ms;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);
  position: relative;
  width: 248px;
  height: 136px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.st-banner {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  padding: 11px 13px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: var(--ml-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--ml-border);
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-md);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  transform-origin: bottom center;
  transition:
    transform calc(var(--s-open) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease),
    opacity calc(var(--s-open) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease),
    filter calc(var(--s-open) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-banner[data-depth="0"] { z-index: 3; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); }
.st-banner[data-depth="1"] { z-index: 2; transform: translateY(-12px) scale(0.94); opacity: 0.72; filter: blur(0.6px); }
.st-banner[data-depth="2"] { z-index: 1; transform: translateY(-22px) scale(0.88); opacity: 0.44; filter: blur(1.2px); }

.st-stack-wrap:hover .st-banner[data-depth="1"],
.st-stack-wrap.is-expanded .st-banner[data-depth="1"] { transform: translateY(-50px) scale(1); opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); }
.st-stack-wrap:hover .st-banner[data-depth="2"],
.st-stack-wrap.is-expanded .st-banner[data-depth="2"] { transform: translateY(-100px) scale(1); opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); }

.st-banner.is-entering {
  transform: translateY(28px) scale(0.96) !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  filter: blur(2px) !important;
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "toast-stack") {
      const messages = [
        ["Build synced", "Just now"],
        ["Preset saved", "2s ago"],
        ["Curve exported", "8s ago"],
        ["Snapshot tagged", "14s ago"]
      ];
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-stack-wrap" data-target role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Notification stack — hover or tap to expand"></div>
        <button type="button" class="st-trigger" data-push>Push Notice</button>
      `;
      const stack = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      const pushBtn = container.querySelector("[data-push]");
      rootTarget = stack;
      let counter = 0;

      function toggleExpand() {
        const exp = stack.classList.toggle("is-expanded");
        stack.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(exp));
        emit(`toast-stack → ${exp ? "expanded (tap toggle)" : "collapsed"}`);
      }
      stack.addEventListener("click", toggleExpand);
      stack.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
          e.preventDefault();
          toggleExpand();
        }
      });

      function addNotice(animate) {
        const pair = messages[counter % messages.length];
        counter++;
        const el = document.createElement("div");
        el.className = animate ? "st-banner is-entering" : "st-banner";
        el.innerHTML = `<strong>${pair[0]} #${counter}</strong><span style="color:var(--ml-ink-muted);font-size:11.5px;">${pair[1]}</span>`;
        stack.prepend(el);
        const items = Array.from(stack.children);
        items.forEach((child, idx) => {
          if (idx > 2) {
            child.remove();
          } else {
            child.setAttribute("data-depth", String(idx));
          }
        });
        if (animate) {
          void el.offsetWidth;
          el.classList.remove("is-entering");
          emit(`toast-stack → pushed "${pair[0]} #${counter}" (depth 0..2)`);
        }
      }
      addNotice(false);
      addNotice(false);
      triggerPrimary = () => addNotice(true);
      pushBtn.addEventListener("click", triggerPrimary);
    }
```

### Segmented Validation Shake (`validation-shake`)
- **Category**: Feedback | **Spec**: 280ms shake · 3s auto-revert | **Triggers**: Click / Auto-revert / Input
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=validation-shake
- **Rationale**: Decaying horizontal oscillations mimic physical rejection while automatically clearing transient error highlights once acknowledged.

#### CSS
```css
/* 8. Segmented Validation Shake */
.st-shake-form {
  --s-dist: 6px;
  --s-dur: 280ms;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);
  width: 244px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.st-shake-input {
  width: 100%;
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--ml-border-strong);
  background: var(--ml-surface);
  font-size: 13px;
  transition: border-color 220ms var(--s-ease), box-shadow 220ms var(--s-ease);
}

.st-shake-form.is-error .st-shake-input {
  border-color: var(--ml-danger);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--ml-danger-soft);
}

.st-shake-form.is-shaking .st-shake-input {
  animation: ml-shake calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-shake-msg {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--ml-danger);
  min-height: 18px;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  transition: opacity 200ms var(--s-ease), transform 200ms var(--s-ease);
}

.st-shake-form.is-error .st-shake-msg {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

@keyframes ml-shake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  22% { transform: translateX(calc(var(--s-dist) * -1)); }
  48% { transform: translateX(var(--s-dist)); }
  74% { transform: translateX(calc(var(--s-dist) * -0.65)); }
  90% { transform: translateX(calc(var(--s-dist) * 0.35)); }
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "validation-shake") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-shake-form" data-target>
          <input type="text" class="st-shake-input" value="hello@motion" aria-label="Email preview" data-inp />
          <div class="st-shake-msg" role="alert">Please enter a complete email address.</div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="st-trigger" data-action>Validate Invalid</button>
      `;
      const form = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      const inp = form.querySelector("[data-inp]");
      const btn = container.querySelector("[data-action]");
      rootTarget = form;
      let revertTimer = null;

      function triggerError() {
        clearTimeout(revertTimer);
        form.classList.remove("is-shaking");
        void form.offsetWidth;
        form.classList.add("is-error", "is-shaking");
        emit("validation-shake → error shake triggered (auto-reverts in 3s)");
        revertTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          form.classList.remove("is-error", "is-shaking");
          emit("validation-shake → auto-reverted to neutral");
        }, 3000);
      }

      btn.addEventListener("click", triggerError);
      inp.addEventListener("input", () => {
        if (form.classList.contains("is-error")) {
          clearTimeout(revertTimer);
          form.classList.remove("is-error", "is-shaking");
          emit("validation-shake → cleared on input");
        }
      });
      cleanups.push(() => clearTimeout(revertTimer));
      triggerPrimary = triggerError;
    }
```

### Composed Success Check (`confirm-check`)
- **Category**: Feedback | **Spec**: 500ms · 80ms stroke delay | **Triggers**: Click Replay / Reset
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=confirm-check
- **Rationale**: Delaying the SVG checkmark stroke by 80ms lets the circular badge establish presence before the tick draws itself.

#### CSS
```css
/* 9. Composed Success Check */
.st-check-wrap {
  --s-dur: 500ms;
  --s-delay: 80ms;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);
  width: 68px;
  height: 68px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.st-check-circle {
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ml-success);
  color: #ffffff;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ml-success) 55%, transparent);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(28px) rotate(65deg) scale(0.8);
  filter: blur(8px);
}

.st-check-wrap.is-in .st-check-circle {
  animation:
    ml-check-fade calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease) forwards,
    ml-check-bob calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--ease-bounce) forwards;
}

.st-check-path {
  stroke-dasharray: 42;
  stroke-dashoffset: 42;
}

.st-check-wrap.is-in .st-check-path {
  animation: ml-check-draw calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease) calc(var(--s-delay) * var(--ml-speed)) forwards;
}

@keyframes ml-check-fade {
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    filter: blur(0);
  }
}

@keyframes ml-check-bob {
  to {
    transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes ml-check-draw {
  to {
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
  }
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "confirm-check") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-check-wrap is-in" data-target>
          <div class="st-check-circle">
            <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
              <path class="st-check-path" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="st-trigger" data-action>Replay Check</button>
      `;
      const wrap = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      const btn = container.querySelector("[data-action]");
      rootTarget = wrap;

      function replay() {
        wrap.classList.remove("is-in");
        void wrap.offsetWidth;
        wrap.classList.add("is-in");
        emit("confirm-check → replayed 5-track check animation");
      }
      btn.addEventListener("click", replay);
      triggerPrimary = replay;
    }
```

### Spring Heart & Particle Burst (`spring-like`)
- **Category**: Micro-Motion | **Spec**: 350ms pop · 600ms burst | **Triggers**: Click / Double-click safe
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.96, 0.64, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=spring-like
- **Rationale**: Asymmetry applies to micro-feedback too: liking celebrates with particles and overshoot while unliking stays quiet and immediate.

#### CSS
```css
/* 10. Spring Heart & Particle Burst */
.st-like-btn {
  --s-pop: 350ms;
  --s-particle: 600ms;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-pop);
  position: relative;
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ml-border-strong);
  background: var(--ml-surface);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-sm);
  transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease;
}

.st-like-btn[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ml-like) 40%, transparent);
  color: var(--ml-like);
}

.st-like-heart {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  fill: transparent;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2;
  transition: fill 150ms ease, stroke 150ms ease;
}

.st-like-btn[aria-pressed="true"] .st-like-heart {
  fill: var(--ml-like);
  stroke: var(--ml-like);
}

.st-like-btn.is-bursting .st-like-heart {
  animation: ml-like-pop calc(var(--s-pop) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease);
}

.st-particle {
  position: absolute;
  left: 26px;
  top: 50%;
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ml-like);
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
}

.st-like-btn.is-bursting .st-particle {
  animation: ml-particle-burst calc(var(--s-particle) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--ease-smooth-out) forwards;
}

@keyframes ml-like-pop {
  0% { transform: scale(0.8); }
  55% { transform: scale(1.24); }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}

@keyframes ml-particle-burst {
  0% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(0, 0) scale(0.5); }
  40% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(calc(var(--px) * 0.55), calc(var(--py) * 0.55)) scale(1.1); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(var(--px), var(--py)) scale(0.2); }
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "spring-like") {
      const angles = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => (i * 40) * Math.PI / 180);
      const particles = angles.map((a) => {
        const r = 24;
        const px = (Math.cos(a) * r).toFixed(1) + "px";
        const py = (Math.sin(a) * r).toFixed(1) + "px";
        return `<span class="st-particle" style="--px:${px};--py:${py}"></span>`;
      }).join("");

      container.innerHTML = `
        <button type="button" class="st-like-btn" aria-pressed="false" data-target>
          ${particles}
          <svg class="st-like-heart" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path d="M12 21.35l-1.45-1.32C5.4 15.36 2 12.28 2 8.5 2 5.42 4.42 3 7.5 3c1.74 0 3.41.81 4.5 2.09C13.09 3.81 14.76 3 16.5 3 19.58 3 22 5.42 22 8.5c0 3.78-3.4 6.86-8.55 11.54L12 21.35z"/>
          </svg>
          <span data-count>42</span>
        </button>
      `;
      const btn = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      const countEl = btn.querySelector("[data-count]");
      rootTarget = btn;
      let liked = false;
      let count = 42;
      let burstTimer = null;

      function toggleLike() {
        liked = !liked;
        count += liked ? 1 : -1;
        btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(liked));
        countEl.textContent = String(count);
        clearTimeout(burstTimer);
        btn.classList.remove("is-bursting");
        if (liked && !isReducedMotion(container)) {
          void btn.offsetWidth;
          btn.classList.add("is-bursting");
          burstTimer = setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove("is-bursting"), 650);
          emit(`spring-like → liked (${count}) + 9-particle burst`);
        } else {
          emit(`spring-like → ${liked ? `liked (${count}, reduced-motion)` : `unliked (${count})`}`);
        }
      }
      btn.addEventListener("click", toggleLike);
      cleanups.push(() => clearTimeout(burstTimer));
      triggerPrimary = toggleLike;
    }
```

### 3D Drum Counter (`drum-counter`)
- **Category**: Micro-Motion | **Spec**: 520ms · 40ms stagger | **Triggers**: Click +12 / +135 / -24
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=drum-counter
- **Rationale**: Direction follows value sign (+ rises from below, - drops from above) and tabular numerals prevent horizontal layout jitter.

#### CSS
```css
/* 11. 3D Drum Counter */
.st-counter-readout {
  --s-dur: 520ms;
  --s-stagger: 40ms;
  --s-blur: 2.5px;
  --s-ease: var(--ease-bounce);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  font-size: 40px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.st-digit-slot {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  overflow: visible;
}

.st-digit-old {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: ml-digit-out calc(var(--s-dur) * 0.36 * var(--ml-speed)) var(--ease-smooth-out) forwards;
}

.st-digit-new {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: ml-digit-in calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--s-ease) var(--stagger-d, 0ms) both;
}

@keyframes ml-digit-out {
  to {
    transform: translateY(calc(-0.46em * var(--dir, 1))) scale(0.75);
    opacity: 0;
    filter: blur(var(--s-blur));
  }
}

@keyframes ml-digit-in {
  from {
    transform: translateY(calc(0.5em * var(--dir, 1))) scale(0.72);
    opacity: 0;
    filter: blur(var(--s-blur));
  }
  to {
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    opacity: 1;
    filter: blur(0);
  }
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "drum-counter") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-counter-readout" data-target aria-live="polite">1,248</div>
        <div class="st-inline-controls">
          <button type="button" class="st-chip-btn" data-delta="-24">-24</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-chip-btn" data-delta="12">+12</button>
          <button type="button" class="st-chip-btn" data-delta="135">+135</button>
        </div>
      `;
      const readout = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      rootTarget = readout;
      let value = 1248;

      function update(delta) {
        const nextValue = Math.max(0, value + delta);
        if (nextValue === value) {
          emit("drum-counter → already at floor (0)");
          return;
        }
        const prev = value.toLocaleString("en-US");
        value = nextValue;
        const next = value.toLocaleString("en-US");
        const dir = delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
        readout.style.setProperty("--dir", String(dir));
        const sameLen = prev.length === next.length;
        readout.innerHTML = "";
        let staggerIdx = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < next.length; i++) {
          const ch = next[i];
          if (sameLen && prev[i] === ch) {
            readout.append(document.createTextNode(ch));
          } else {
            const slot = document.createElement("span");
            slot.className = "st-digit-slot";
            if (sameLen) {
              const oldEl = document.createElement("span");
              oldEl.className = "st-digit-old";
              oldEl.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
              oldEl.textContent = prev[i];
              slot.appendChild(oldEl);
            }
            const newEl = document.createElement("span");
            newEl.className = "st-digit-new";
            newEl.style.setProperty("--stagger-d", `calc(var(--s-stagger) * ${staggerIdx})`);
            newEl.textContent = ch;
            slot.appendChild(newEl);
            readout.appendChild(slot);
            staggerIdx++;
          }
        }
        emit(`drum-counter → ${prev} → ${next} (${staggerIdx} digits animated)`);
      }

      container.querySelectorAll("[data-delta]").forEach((b) => {
        b.addEventListener("click", () => update(Number(b.dataset.delta)));
      });
      triggerPrimary = () => update(135);
    }
```

### Magnetic Avatar Wave & 3D Tilt (`hover-cluster`)
- **Category**: Micro-Motion | **Spec**: 320ms wave · 3D glare | **Triggers**: Hover / Tap / Pointermove / Leave
- **Default Easing**: `cubic-bezier(0.34, 3.85, 0.64, 1)`
- **Workbench**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=hover-cluster
- **Rationale**: Neighbor displacement decays exponentially (0.45^distance) on hover-in and snaps back with a lively spring curve on mouse leave.

#### CSS
```css
/* 12. Magnetic Avatar Wave & 3D Tilt */
.st-cluster-wrap {
  --s-dur: 320ms;
  --s-lift: -6px;
  --s-ease-in: var(--ease-smooth-out);
  --s-ease-out: var(--ease-bounce-strong);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}

.st-avatar-row {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 6px;
}

.st-avatar {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ml-surface);
  margin-left: -10px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-sm);
  transform: translateY(var(--shift, 0px)) scale(var(--scale, 1));
  transition: transform calc(var(--s-dur) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--avatar-ease, var(--s-ease-in));
}

.st-avatar:first-child {
  margin-left: 0;
}

.st-tilt-card {
  --rx: 0deg;
  --ry: 0deg;
  --gx: 50%;
  --gy: 50%;
  --go: 0;
  --s-return: 850ms;
  position: relative;
  width: 214px;
  height: 102px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #161b26 0%, #24345c 100%);
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: var(--ml-shadow-md);
  transform: perspective(900px) rotateX(var(--rx)) rotateY(var(--ry));
  transition: transform calc(var(--s-return) * var(--ml-speed)) var(--ease-smooth-out);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.st-tilt-card.is-tilting {
  transition: transform 90ms linear;
}

.st-tilt-glare {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at var(--gx) var(--gy), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34), transparent 58%);
  opacity: var(--go);
  transition: opacity 260ms var(--ease-smooth-out);
}
```

#### JS Controller
```js
else if (id === "hover-cluster") {
      const colors = ["#2257F2", "#0D9468", "#D97706", "#E11D48", "#7C3AED"];
      const initials = ["KL", "MR", "AN", "JT", "SY"];
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="st-cluster-wrap" data-target>
          <div class="st-avatar-row" data-avatars>
            ${initials.map((t, i) => `<div class="st-avatar" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Avatar ${t}" style="background:${colors[i]}" data-av="${i}">${t}</div>`).join("")}
          </div>
          <div class="st-tilt-card" data-tilt>
            <div class="st-tilt-glare"></div>
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;opacity:.75;font-family:var(--ml-font-mono);">
              <span>STUDIO PASS</span><span>3D TILT</span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.01em;">Move pointer to tilt</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      const wrap = container.querySelector("[data-target]");
      const row = wrap.querySelector("[data-avatars]");
      const avs = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll("[data-av]"));
      const tilt = wrap.querySelector("[data-tilt]");
      rootTarget = wrap;
      let waveTimer = null;

      function resetRest() {
        avs.forEach((el) => {
          el.style.setProperty("--shift", "0px");
          el.style.setProperty("--scale", "1");
        });
        tilt.classList.remove("is-tilting");
        tilt.style.setProperty("--rx", "0deg");
        tilt.style.setProperty("--ry", "0deg");
        tilt.style.setProperty("--go", "0");
      }

      function setWave(activeIdx, isLeave) {
        if (isReducedMotion(container)) {
          resetRest();
          return;
        }
        const liftVal = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(wrap).getPropertyValue("--s-lift")) || -6;
        const ease = isLeave ? "var(--s-ease-out)" : "var(--s-ease-in)";
        avs.forEach((el, i) => {
          el.style.setProperty("--avatar-ease", ease);
          if (activeIdx === null) {
            el.style.setProperty("--shift", "0px");
            el.style.setProperty("--scale", "1");
            return;
          }
          const d = Math.abs(i - activeIdx);
          const shift = (liftVal * Math.pow(0.45, d)).toFixed(2) + "px";
          el.style.setProperty("--shift", shift);
          el.style.setProperty("--scale", i === activeIdx ? "1.08" : "1");
        });
      }

      avs.forEach((el, i) => {
        el.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
          setWave(i, false);
          emit(`avatar-wave → hover index ${i} (${initials[i]})`);
        });
        el.addEventListener("focus", () => setWave(i, false));
        el.addEventListener("blur", () => setWave(null, true));
        el.addEventListener("click", () => {
          clearTimeout(waveTimer);
          setWave(i, false);
          waveTimer = setTimeout(() => setWave(null, true), 450);
          emit(`avatar-wave → tap index ${i} (${initials[i]})`);
        });
      });
      row.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        setWave(null, true);
        emit("avatar-wave → bouncy spring return");
      });

      tilt.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
        if (isReducedMotion(container)) {
          resetRest();
          return;
        }
        const r = tilt.getBoundingClientRect();
        const px = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width;
        const py = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
        const ry = ((px - 0.5) * 24).toFixed(2) + "deg";
        const rx = ((0.5 - py) * 18).toFixed(2) + "deg";
        tilt.classList.add("is-tilting");
        tilt.style.setProperty("--rx", rx);
        tilt.style.setProperty("--ry", ry);
        tilt.style.setProperty("--gx", (px * 100).toFixed(1) + "%");
        tilt.style.setProperty("--gy", (py * 100).toFixed(1) + "%");
        tilt.style.setProperty("--go", "1");
      });
      tilt.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
        tilt.classList.remove("is-tilting");
        tilt.style.setProperty("--rx", "0deg");
        tilt.style.setProperty("--ry", "0deg");
        tilt.style.setProperty("--go", "0");
        emit("3d-tilt → smooth return to rest");
      });

      cleanups.push(() => clearTimeout(waveTimer));
      triggerPrimary = () => {
        clearTimeout(waveTimer);
        if (isReducedMotion(container)) {
          resetRest();
          emit("hover-cluster → suppressed under Reduced Motion");
          return;
        }
        setWave(2, false);
        waveTimer = setTimeout(() => setWave(null, true), 450);
      };
    }
```

### Pulse Climate Dial (`pulse-climate`)

#### JS Controller & Markup
```js
if (id === "pulse-climate") {
      const gradId = `mlPulseGrad_${uid}`;
      const ticks = Array.from({ length: 36 }, (_, i) => {
        const deg = -135 + (i / 35) * 270;
        return `<line x1="110" y1="12" x2="110" y2="${i % 5 === 0 ? 21 : 17}" stroke="rgba(17,17,20,0.16)" stroke-width="${i % 5 === 0 ? 1.8 : 1.1}" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(${deg} 110 110)"/>`;
      }).join("");

      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="uiw uiw-pulse">
          <div class="uiw-pulse-glow" data-glow></div>
          <div class="uiw-head">
            <div>
              <div class="uiw-h-title">Living Studio</div>
              <div class="uiw-h-sub">Radiant climate · Auto fan</div>
            </div>
            <div class="uiw-stat-pill"><span style="width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#10b981"></span><span class="uiw-tnum">42% RH</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="uiw-dial-wrap">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 220 220" width="212" height="212" aria-hidden="true">
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="${gradId}" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
                  <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#38bdf8"/>
                  <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#f59e0b"/>
                  <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ef4444"/>
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>
              ${ticks}
              <circle cx="110" cy="110" r="80" fill="none" stroke="#eeeef2" stroke-width="11" stroke-dasharray="377 503" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(135 110 110)"/>
              <circle data-arc cx="110" cy="110" r="80" fill="none" stroke="url(#${gradId})" stroke-width="11" stroke-dasharray="190 503" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(135 110 110)" style="transition:stroke-dasharray 280ms var(--ease-smooth-out)"/>
              <g data-knob style="transition:transform 280ms var(--ease-bounce);transform-origin:110px 110px">
                <circle cx="110" cy="30" r="8.5" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#111114" stroke-width="2.5"/>
              </g>
            </svg>
            <div class="uiw-dial-center">
              <div class="uiw-temp-val uiw-tnum" data-temp>22.0°</div>
              <div class="uiw-dial-lbl" data-lbl>Balanced comfort</div>
              <div class="uiw-steppers">
                <button type="button" class="uiw-circle-btn" data-minus aria-label="Decrease temperature">−</button>
                <button type="button" class="uiw-circle-btn" data-plus aria-label="Increase temperature">+</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="uiw-seg" role="tablist" aria-label="Climate mood">
            <div class="uiw-seg-thumb" data-thumb></div>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-seg-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="false" data-m="0">Eco</button>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-seg-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="true" data-m="1">Comfort</button>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-seg-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="false" data-m="2">Warm Glow</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      let temp = 22.0;
      let mood = 1;
      const arc = container.querySelector("[data-arc]");
      const knob = container.querySelector("[data-knob]");
      const tempEl = container.querySelector("[data-temp]");
      const lbl = container.querySelector("[data-lbl]");
      const glow = container.querySelector("[data-glow]");
      const thumb = container.querySelector("[data-thumb]");
      const moodBtns = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[data-m]"));

      function sync() {
        const frac = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (temp - 16) / 12));
        tempEl.textContent = `${temp.toFixed(1)}°`;
        arc.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", `${(frac * 377).toFixed(1)} 503`);
        knob.style.transform = `rotate(${(-135 + frac * 270).toFixed(1)}deg)`;
        thumb.style.transform = `translateX(${mood * 100}%)`;
        moodBtns.forEach((b, i) => b.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(i === mood)));
        if (mood === 2) {
          glow.style.background = "radial-gradient(circle, #f97316, #fbbf24 55%, transparent 75%)";
          lbl.textContent = "Warm Glow active";
        } else if (mood === 0) {
          glow.style.background = "radial-gradient(circle, #34d399, #38bdf8 55%, transparent 75%)";
          lbl.textContent = "Eco saver mode";
        } else {
          glow.style.background = "radial-gradient(circle, #38bdf8, #818cf8 55%, transparent 75%)";
          lbl.textContent = temp >= 23 ? "Warming studio…" : "Balanced comfort";
        }
      }

      container.querySelector("[data-minus]").addEventListener("click", () => {
        temp = Math.max(16, Math.round((temp - 0.5) * 10) / 10);
        sync();
      });
      container.querySelector("[data-plus]").addEventListener("click", () => {
        temp = Math.min(28, Math.round((temp + 0.5) * 10) / 10);
        sync();
      });
      moodBtns.forEach((b) => {
        b.addEventListener("click", () => {
          mood = Number(b.dataset.m);
          if (mood === 0) temp = 19.5;
          if (mood === 1) temp = 22.0;
          if (mood === 2) temp = 24.5;
          sync();
        });
      });
      sync();
    }
```

### Orbit Live Flight Pass (`orbit-flight`)
- **Category**: Cards | **Triggers**: Switch Live Route / Gate B14 / Boarding
- **Tokens**: `--ease-smooth-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); --dur-tab: 300ms;`
- **Preview**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#orbit-flight
- **Summary**: Cobalt aviation tracker with SVG great-circle flight path, pulsing radar plane indicator, and live boarding tab transition.

```js
          <div class="uiw-seg" role="tablist" aria-label="Flight view">
            <div class="uiw-seg-thumb" data-thumb></div>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-seg-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="true" data-t="0">Live Route</button>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-seg-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="false" data-t="1">Gate B14</button>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-seg-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="false" data-t="2">Boarding</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      const states = [
        { pt: 0.58, badge: "On Time · 38,000 ft", boarding: false, v1: "58%", v2: "B14", v3: "14A" },
        { pt: 0.72, badge: "Terminal 3 · 4m walk", boarding: false, v1: "72%", v2: "B14 · T3", v3: "14A" },
        { pt: 0.84, badge: "● Boarding · Group 1", boarding: true, v1: "84%", v2: "B14 · T3", v3: "14A · G1" }
      ];
      const badge = container.querySelector("[data-badge]");
      const pathEl = container.querySelector("[data-path]");
      const planeEl = container.querySelector("[data-plane]");
      const thumb = container.querySelector("[data-thumb]");
      const tabs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[data-t]"));

      function setTab(i) {
        const s = states[i];
        tabs.forEach((b, idx) => b.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(idx === i)));
        thumb.style.transform = `translateX(${i * 100}%)`;
        badge.textContent = s.badge;
        badge.classList.toggle("is-boarding", s.boarding);
        container.querySelector("[data-v1]").textContent = s.v1;
        container.querySelector("[data-v2]").textContent = s.v2;
        container.querySelector("[data-v3]").textContent = s.v3;

        const pt = s.pt;
        const bx = (1 - pt) * (1 - pt) * 14 + 2 * (1 - pt) * pt * 180 + pt * pt * 346;
        const by = (1 - pt) * (1 - pt) * 70 + 2 * (1 - pt) * pt * (-6) + pt * pt * 70;
        planeEl.style.transform = `translate(${bx.toFixed(1)}px, ${by.toFixed(1)}px)`;
        pathEl.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", `${(pt * 356).toFixed(1)} 380`);
      }

      tabs.forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => setTab(Number(b.dataset.t))));
      setTab(0);
    }
```

### Tempo Spatial Audio Deck (`tempo-audio`)
- **Category**: Media | **Triggers**: Play / Pause · Switch Studio / Warm / Spatial
- **Tokens**: `--dur-eq: 140ms; --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1);`
- **Preview**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#tempo-audio
- **Summary**: Obsidian hi-fi vinyl player with 18-bar animated harmonic equalizer and color-shifting Studio / Warm / Spatial sound presets.

#### CSS
```css
/* 3. TEMPO SPATIAL AUDIO DECK */
.uiw-tempo {
  padding: 20px 22px;

  box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);

  min-height: 8px;

}

.uiw.is-dark .uiw-seg {

  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

  background: #262630;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

.uiw.is-dark .uiw-seg-btn { color: #8b8b96; }
.uiw.is-dark .uiw-seg-btn[aria-selected="true"] { color: #ffffff; }
```

#### JS Controller & Markup
```js
else if (id === "tempo-audio") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="uiw is-dark uiw-tempo">
          <div class="uiw-tempo-glow" data-glow></div>
          <div class="uiw-head">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px">
              <div class="uiw-vinyl" data-vinyl></div>
              <div>
                <div class="uiw-h-title">Midnight Tape</div>
                <div class="uiw-h-sub" data-sub>Analog Sessions · 96kHz FLAC</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-play-btn" data-play aria-label="Play or pause track">
              <span data-play-ico>▶</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          <div class="uiw-eq-stage">
            ${Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => `<div class="uiw-eq-bar" data-bar="${i}" style="height:22%"></div>`).join("")}
          </div>
          <div class="uiw-seg" role="tablist" aria-label="Sound preset">
            <div class="uiw-seg-thumb" data-thumb></div>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-seg-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="true" data-p="0">Studio</button>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-seg-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="false" data-p="1">Warm</button>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-seg-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="false" data-p="2">Spatial</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      let playing = true;
      let preset = 0;
      let phase = 0;
      const bars = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[data-bar]"));
      const glow = container.querySelector("[data-glow]");
      const sub = container.querySelector("[data-sub]");
      const thumb = container.querySelector("[data-thumb]");
      const playIco = container.querySelector("[data-play-ico]");
      const vinyl = container.querySelector("[data-vinyl]");
      const presetBtns = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[data-p]"));
      const presets = [
        { sub: "Analog Sessions · 96kHz FLAC", glow: "radial-gradient(circle,#a78bfa,#6366f1 60%,transparent)", grad: "linear-gradient(180deg,#c4b5fd,#818cf8 65%,rgba(129,140,248,0.22))" },
        { sub: "Warm Tube EQ · +4dB Low", glow: "radial-gradient(circle,#f59e0b,#ec4899 60%,transparent)", grad: "linear-gradient(180deg,#fcd34d,#f97316 65%,rgba(249,115,22,0.22))" },
        { sub: "Spatial Atmos · 360° Stage", glow: "radial-gradient(circle,#38bdf8,#a78bfa 60%,transparent)", grad: "linear-gradient(180deg,#67e8f9,#818cf8 65%,rgba(129,140,248,0.22))" }
      ];

      function renderEq() {
        const cfg = presets[preset];
        glow.style.background = cfg.glow;
        sub.textContent = cfg.sub;
        thumb.style.transform = `translateX(${preset * 100}%)`;
        playIco.textContent = playing ? "❚❚" : "▶";
        presetBtns.forEach((b, i) => b.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(i === preset)));
        bars.forEach((bar, i) => {
          const norm = i / (bars.length - 1);
          const bias = 1 - Math.abs(norm - 0.5) * (preset === 2 ? 0.5 : 1.1);
          const warm = preset === 1 ? (1 - norm) * 0.34 : 0;
          const wave = 0.5 + 0.34 * Math.sin(phase + i * 0.6) + 0.16 * Math.cos(phase * 0.7 - i);
          const h = playing ? 16 + Math.min(1, Math.max(0.12, wave * bias + warm)) * 78 : 14 + (i % 3) * 5;
          bar.style.height = `${h.toFixed(1)}%`;
          bar.style.background = cfg.grad;
        });
        vinyl.style.transform = `rotate(${(phase * 28).toFixed(1)}deg)`;
      }

      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        if (playing && !(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches)) {
          phase += 0.32;
          renderEq();
        }
      }, 130);
      cleanups.push(() => clearInterval(timer));

      container.querySelector("[data-play]").addEventListener("click", () => {
        playing = !playing;
        renderEq();
      });
      presetBtns.forEach((b) => {
        b.addEventListener("click", () => {
          preset = Number(b.dataset.p);
          renderEq();
        });
      });
      renderEq();
    }
```

```js
      copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (window.MotionLabApp) window.MotionLabApp.copyText(themes[active].css, `Copied ${themes[active].name} CSS`);
        copyBtn.textContent = "✓ Copied";
        setTimeout(() => { copyBtn.textContent = "Copy CSS"; }, 1400);
      });
    }
```

### Focus Deep Work Timer (`focus-timer`)

#### JS Controller & Markup
```js
else if (id === "focus-timer") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="uiw is-warm uiw-focus">
          <div class="uiw-head">
            <div class="uiw-h-title">Deep Work</div>
            <div class="uiw-stat-pill" data-st style="background:#efe9df;color:#78716c">● Ready · 25m</div>
          </div>
          <div class="uiw-focus-ring">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 180 180" width="166" height="166" aria-hidden="true">
              <circle cx="90" cy="90" r="74" fill="none" stroke="#e9e2d6" stroke-width="9"/>
              <circle data-ring cx="90" cy="90" r="74" fill="none" stroke="#dc5c3b" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="465" stroke-dashoffset="465" transform="rotate(-90 90 90)" style="transition:stroke-dashoffset 320ms var(--ease-smooth-out)"/>
            </svg>
            <div class="uiw-focus-center">
              <div class="uiw-focus-digits uiw-mono" data-time>25:00</div>
              <div class="uiw-h-sub" data-sub>Sprint block #2</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="uiw-focus-btn" data-toggle>Start Focus</button>
          <div class="uiw-sound-row">
            <button type="button" class="uiw-sound-btn" aria-pressed="false" data-sound="Rain">Rain</button>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-sound-btn" aria-pressed="false" data-sound="Vinyl">Vinyl</button>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-sound-btn" aria-pressed="false" data-sound="Forest">Forest</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      let running = false;
      let remaining = 1500;
      let activeSound = "";
      const ring = container.querySelector("[data-ring]");
      const timeEl = container.querySelector("[data-time]");
      const stEl = container.querySelector("[data-st]");
      const subEl = container.querySelector("[data-sub]");
      const toggleBtn = container.querySelector("[data-toggle]");
      const soundBtns = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[data-sound]"));

      function sync() {
        const mm = String(Math.floor(remaining / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
        const ss = String(remaining % 60).padStart(2, "0");
        timeEl.textContent = `${mm}:${ss}`;
        const pct = running ? Math.max(0.08, (1500 - remaining) / 60) : (1500 - remaining) / 60;
        ring.setAttribute("stroke-dashoffset", String((465 * (1 - Math.min(1, pct))).toFixed(1)));
        toggleBtn.textContent = running ? "Pause Session" : "Start Focus";
        toggleBtn.classList.toggle("is-running", running);
        stEl.textContent = running ? "● In Flow" : "● Ready · 25m";
        stEl.style.background = running ? "#fdece7" : "#efe9df";
        stEl.style.color = running ? "#c2410c" : "#78716c";
        subEl.textContent = activeSound ? `${activeSound} ambience · active` : (running ? "Notifications muted" : "Sprint block #2");
      }

      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        if (running && remaining > 0) {
          remaining--;
          sync();
        }
      }, 1000);
      cleanups.push(() => clearInterval(timer));

      toggleBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        running = !running;
        sync();
      });
      soundBtns.forEach((b) => {
        b.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const name = b.dataset.sound;
          activeSound = activeSound === name ? "" : name;
          soundBtns.forEach((x) => x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(x.dataset.sound === activeSound)));
          sync();
        });
      });
      sync();
    }
```

### Forge Edge Deploy Pipeline (`forge-deploy`)

```js
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="uiw is-dark uiw-forge">
          <div class="uiw-head">
            <div>
              <div class="uiw-h-title">motion-lab</div>
              <div class="uiw-h-sub uiw-mono">main · 4a9e2f · v2.0</div>
            </div>
            <div class="uiw-stat-pill uiw-mono" data-pill style="background:rgba(148,163,184,0.16);color:#cbd5e1">Ready</div>
          </div>
          <div class="uiw-forge-steps">
            ${steps.map((s, i) => `
              <div class="uiw-forge-row" data-row="${i}">
                <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px"><span class="uiw-forge-ico" data-ico="${i}">○</span><span>${s[0]}</span></span>
                <span class="uiw-mono" style="font-size:11px;color:#64748b" data-tm="${i}">${s[1]}</span>
              </div>`).join("")}
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="uiw-forge-cta" data-deploy>Deploy Release</button>
        </div>
      `;

      const rows = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[data-row]"));
      const icos = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[data-ico]"));
      const tms = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[data-tm]"));
      const pill = container.querySelector("[data-pill]");
      const btn = container.querySelector("[data-deploy]");
      let timers = [];
      let state = "idle"; // idle | building | live

      function clearTimers() {
        timers.forEach(clearTimeout);
        timers = [];
      }
      cleanups.push(clearTimers);

      function resetRows() {
        rows.forEach((r, i) => {
          r.className = "uiw-forge-row";
          icos[i].textContent = "○";
          tms[i].style.color = "#64748b";
        });
      }

      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        clearTimers();
        resetRows();
        state = "building";
        btn.className = "uiw-forge-cta is-building";
        btn.textContent = "Deploying release…";
        pill.textContent = "● Building…";
        pill.style.background = "rgba(183,164,255,0.2)";
        pill.style.color = "#c4b5fd";

        steps.forEach((_, idx) => {
          timers.push(setTimeout(() => {
            rows[idx].classList.add("is-active");
            icos[idx].textContent = "◌";
          }, idx * 420));
          timers.push(setTimeout(() => {
            rows[idx].classList.remove("is-active");
            rows[idx].classList.add("is-done");
            icos[idx].textContent = "✓";
            tms[idx].style.color = "#34d399";
            if (idx === steps.length - 1) {
              state = "live";
              btn.className = "uiw-forge-cta is-live";
              btn.textContent = "✓ Deployed to Edge (Redeploy)";
              pill.textContent = "● Live · 14ms";
              pill.style.background = "rgba(52,211,153,0.18)";
              pill.style.color = "#34d399";
            }
          }, idx * 420 + 360));
        });
      });
    }
```

### Design Shelf 3D Deck (`shelf-books`)
- **Category**: Media | **Triggers**: Click ‹ / › or Covers · Toggle Bookmark
- **Tokens**: `--dur-deck: 360ms; --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1);`
- **Preview**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#shelf-books
- **Summary**: Tactile Swiss graphic book cover-flow with perspective depth stacking, synced reading progress bar, and spring bookmark toggle.

#### CSS
```css
/* 7. SHELF 3D BOOK DECK */
.uiw-shelf {
  padding: 20px 22px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.uiw-shelf-deck {
  position: relative;
  height: 196px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.uiw-book {
  position: absolute;
  width: 132px;
  height: 176px;
  border-radius: 11px 15px 15px 11px;
  padding: 15px 13px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 32px -10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.26), inset 3px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
  transition: transform 360ms var(--ease-bounce), opacity 300ms ease;
}

.uiw-shelf-arrow {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #18181b;
  font-size: 16px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
  z-index: 15;
}

.uiw-shelf-arrow.is-left { left: 0; }
.uiw-shelf-arrow.is-right { right: 0; }

.uiw-shelf-bar {
  padding: 10px 13px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: #f8f8fa;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
}

.uiw-prog-track {
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.uiw-prog-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: #111114;
  transition: width 320ms var(--ease-smooth-out);
}
```

#### JS Controller & Markup
```js
else if (id === "shelf-books") {
      const books = [
        { kicker: "EDITION 01", name: "Grid<br/>Systems", author: "Swiss Layout Archive", title: "Grid Systems", pct: 48, bg: "linear-gradient(155deg,#1d4ed8,#1e3a8a)", fg: "#eff6ff", bar: "#93c5fd" },
        { kicker: "EDITION 02", name: "Kinetic<br/>Craft", author: "Interactive Motion", title: "Kinetic Craft", pct: 76, bg: "linear-gradient(155deg,#ea580c,#9a3412)", fg: "#fff7ed", bar: "#fed7aa" },
        { kicker: "EDITION 03", name: "Spatial<br/>Type", author: "Variable Systems", title: "Spatial Type", pct: 90, bg: "linear-gradient(155deg,#0f172a,#1e293b)", fg: "#f8fafc", bar: "#34d399" }
      ];
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="uiw uiw-shelf">
          <div class="uiw-head">
            <div><div class="uiw-h-title">Design Shelf</div><div class="uiw-h-sub">3 editions · Click arrows or covers</div></div>
            <button type="button" class="ml-mini-btn" data-bm aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Bookmark edition">☆ Save</button>
          </div>
          <div class="uiw-shelf-deck">
            <button type="button" class="uiw-shelf-arrow is-left" data-prev aria-label="Previous edition">‹</button>
            ${books.map((b, i) => `
              <div class="uiw-book" data-bk="${i}" style="background:${b.bg};color:${b.fg};cursor:pointer">
                <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;opacity:.78">${b.kicker}</div>
                <div>
                  <div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-0.03em;line-height:1.08">${b.name}</div>
                  <div style="width:30px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:${b.bar};margin-top:9px"></div>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size:10px;opacity:.82">${b.author}</div>
              </div>`).join("")}
            <button type="button" class="uiw-shelf-arrow is-right" data-next aria-label="Next edition">›</button>
          </div>
          <div class="uiw-shelf-bar">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600">
              <span data-title>Kinetic Craft</span><span class="uiw-mono" data-pct>76%</span>
            </div>
            <div class="uiw-prog-track"><div class="uiw-prog-fill" data-fill style="width:76%"></div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      let idx = 1;
      let saved = false;
      const bkEls = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("[data-bk]"));
      const bmBtn = container.querySelector("[data-bm]");

      function sync() {
        bkEls.forEach((el, i) => {
          const rel = i - idx;
          el.style.zIndex = String(10 - Math.abs(rel) * 3);
          el.style.opacity = String(1 - Math.abs(rel) * 0.24);
          el.style.transform = `translateX(${rel * 92}px) translateY(${Math.abs(rel) * 8}px) scale(${1 - Math.abs(rel) * 0.16}) rotate(${-rel * 8}deg)`;
        });
        container.querySelector("[data-title]").textContent = books[idx].title;
        container.querySelector("[data-pct]").textContent = `${books[idx].pct}%`;
        container.querySelector("[data-fill]").style.width = `${books[idx].pct}%`;
      }

      container.querySelector("[data-prev]").addEventListener("click", () => { idx = (idx + books.length - 1) % books.length; sync(); });
      container.querySelector("[data-next]").addEventListener("click", () => { idx = (idx + 1) % books.length; sync(); });
      bkEls.forEach((el) => el.addEventListener("click", () => { idx = Number(el.dataset.bk); sync(); }));
      bmBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        saved = !saved;
        bmBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(saved));
        bmBtn.textContent = saved ? "★ Saved" : "☆ Save";
        bmBtn.style.color = saved ? "#e11d48" : "";
      });
      sync();
    }
```

### Relay Issue Triage Card (`relay-triage`)
- **Category**: Productivity | **Triggers**: Toggle Priority · Click Ship PR · Toggle Reactions
- **Tokens**: `--dur-micro: 160ms; --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1);`
- **Preview**: https://17860288878k-debug.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#relay-triage
- **Summary**: Linear-inspired engineering issue card with interactive priority escalation, Ship PR state morph, QA bar fill, and reaction toggles.

#### CSS

#### JS Controller & Markup
```js
else if (id === "relay-triage") {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="uiw uiw-relay">
          <div class="uiw-head">
            <span class="uiw-stat-pill uiw-mono">ML-402</span>
            <span class="uiw-stat-pill" data-st style="background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca">● In Review</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.025em">Spring Physics Engine</div>
            <div class="uiw-h-sub" style="margin-top:4px">Interruptible gesture curves &amp; reduced-motion guard.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="uiw-relay-props">
            <div>
              <div style="font-size:11px;color:#8b8b96;margin-bottom:5px">Priority</div>
              <button type="button" class="uiw-relay-pill" data-prio>● Medium</button>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style="font-size:11px;color:#8b8b96;margin-bottom:5px">QA Checks</div>
              <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600" data-checks>11 / 12 passed</div>
              <div class="uiw-prog-track" style="margin-top:5px"><div class="uiw-prog-fill" data-bar style="width:78%;background:#6366f1"></div></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.08)">
            <div style="display:flex;gap:6px">
              <button type="button" class="uiw-react-chip" aria-pressed="false" data-react="fire">🔥 <span data-cnt>12</span></button>
              <button type="button" class="uiw-react-chip" aria-pressed="false" data-react="zap">⚡ <span data-cnt>8</span></button>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="uiw-ship-btn" data-ship>Ship PR</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      let urgent = false;
      let shipped = false;
      const prioBtn = container.querySelector("[data-prio]");
      const stEl = container.querySelector("[data-st]");
      const shipBtn = container.querySelector("[data-ship]");
      const checksEl = container.querySelector("[data-checks]");
      const barEl = container.querySelector("[data-bar]");

      prioBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        urgent = !urgent;
        prioBtn.classList.toggle("is-urgent", urgent);
        prioBtn.textContent = urgent ? "▲ Urgent" : "● Medium";
      });

      shipBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        shipped = !shipped;
        shipBtn.classList.toggle("is-shipped", shipped);
        shipBtn.textContent = shipped ? "✓ Shipped" : "Ship PR";
        stEl.textContent = shipped ? "● Shipped" : "● In Review";
        stEl.style.background = shipped ? "#ecfdf5" : "#eef2ff";
        stEl.style.color = shipped ? "#059669" : "#4338ca";
        checksEl.textContent = shipped ? "12 / 12 passed" : "11 / 12 passed";
        barEl.style.width = shipped ? "100%" : "78%";
        barEl.style.background = shipped ? "#10b981" : "#6366f1";
      });

      container.querySelectorAll("[data-react]").forEach((btn) => {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const active = btn.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true";
          const next = !active;
          btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(next));
          const cnt = btn.querySelector("[data-cnt]");
          cnt.textContent = String(Number(cnt.textContent) + (next ? 1 : -1));
        });
      });
    }
```
